scenarios.title: Vault: a gold reveal buys the scrolls and reveals every held item
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level, gold and stash gold by stat verbs; the unidentified vault records are real magic items given by `debug give ... unid` and taken into the vault by the runner WITHOUT held affixes (bare: the shape of a record the fork sent none for), so the gold order must decode their own bytes (`item decode`). UNMEASURED run: the reveal pays from the stash with `debug paygold` (ADR 0029), a player-paid write the fork refuses under --lockstep, so the bot phase runs d2d in real time with --vault-pay; the one paygold write per order is the thing under test. Mechanics evidence only, never balance.

assert.why: 6 reveals at 80 (480) left the stash: 7200 less the bot's own town spending (real time, unmeasured run: about 50 to 1700 in the runs seen) less 480
the order took 480 gold, 80 per item, from the stash (the bot plays in real time and spends some purse and stash gold of its own, so the purse is not asserted)

scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 6 unidentified held items (vault records), 5000 gold in the purse and none in the stash, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1, an order for all 6 posted before the first town visit. Expected: all 6 records identified, the purse down by about 6 scrolls at the vendor price (80 each) and not below the potion-kit reserve, no item sold, the order ends done. RED on today's main is the order route not existing; GREEN is the physical chain buy, read, supersede. Records are bare (no held affixes): the order decodes each record's own bytes, pays from the stash and reveals in the same request; no scroll, no town visit, no item created in the hero.

scenarios.title: Vault: Identify all reveals the whole vault in one order and takes the exact gold from the stash
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level, gold and stash gold by stat verbs; 30 unidentified vault records are real magic items given by `debug give ... unid` and taken into the vault by the runner, 20 of them WITHOUT held affixes (bare, so the order decodes their own bytes) and 10 with held affixes. UNMEASURED run: the order pays from the stash with `debug paygold` (ADR 0029), a player-paid write the fork refuses under --lockstep, so the bot phase runs d2d in real time with --vault-pay; the one paygold write per order is the thing under test. Mechanics evidence only, never balance.

assert.why: the whole-vault order was accepted without any id (ok is false when a record the game cannot decode stays sealed)
every unrevealed record is revealed, sealed or bare; one bare record may carry no affix the game can decode (seen live: a socketed magic armor), it stays sealed and is reported
the one order took 80 gold per revealed record from the stash (one paygold ledger line, once per order id)
the order reports the revealed count
after the order at most the one undecodable record is still counted
7200 less the order, less the bot own town spending in real time (about 50 to 1700 in the runs seen)

scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 30 unidentified vault records (20 bare, 10 sealed), stash 7200, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1. One POST {scope: all_unrevealed} with no ids: the bot lists the records itself, pays 2400 from the stash in one paygold request and reveals all 30 in the same request. RED before the scope exists is a 400 on the body; GREEN is 30 revealed and the exact gold gone.
